notes: P3-OPT-091: MAP-P3 parameter sweep — vary ONLY signal_blend_weight.
Baseline (no signal_blend_weight param): primary POC reversion signal only, w_eff=1.0.

Variant: signal_blend_weight=0.5 — blend primary POC reversion (binary -1/0/+1) with secondary momentum confirmation (close vs N-bar return, N=20). Final entry score = w*poc + (1-w)*mom; threshold score>=0.5 long, score<=-0.5 short. With w=0.5, primary OR secondary alone suffices (more permissive than baseline).
All other params identical to baseline.
